featured_reviews.name: Jaimeen Bulsara
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a wonderful experience at Ajanta Cinex. This was our second time coming here. The movie watching experience itself is amazing, it is currently the only single screen theatre with Dolby sound system. Clean, comfortable seating, delicious food options (we tried the momos, pizza, and coffee, along with the usual samosa and popcorn). The freshly made momos and pizza were better than some of the food places we’ve eaten at. Overall a total 5 on 5 experience. Would definitely come again soon.

featured_reviews.name: Jeevan Nagarkar
featured_reviews.review_text: The staff seemed untrained. featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Maxus Cinemas on Gorai Road, Borivali West recently. Overall, the experience was decent, but there are a few areas that need improvement.

The biggest disappointment was that the movie started almost 30 minutes late, which was quite frustrating and affected the overall experience. The management should ensure better punctuality and timely show schedules.

The theatre is clean and the seating is comfortable. Food quality was surprisingly good, with decent options available and fresh snacks. However, the sound quality was slightly below expectations. The audio lacked depth and could definitely be improved for a better cinematic experience.

Despite these issues, the ambience is pleasant and it's still a good option for a casual movie outing with friends and family. Hoping they improve the sound system and maintain better show timings in the future.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Honestly, really disappointed with my experience at Maxsus Cinema. The picture quality was extremely poor — the screen looked blurry, as if the sharpness wasn’t even set properly. For a premium theatre, this is just unacceptable.

On top of that, the audio was even worse. The speakers were crackling throughout, completely ruining the movie experience. Instead of immersive sound, it felt like sitting next to a broken speaker system.

Overall, not worth the money at all. Definitely expected much better from a brand like this.

Maxus Theatre, Borivali offers a consistently enjoyable movie-watching experience. The ambience is pleasant, seating is comfortable, and the overall layout of the theatre is well maintained, making it a great place to unwind and enjoy a film.

Today I visited INOX at Raghuleela Mega Mall, Kandivali, and overall it was a pleasant movie-watching experience. The theatre is conveniently located inside the mall and easy to reach by public transport as well as private vehicles. Entry and security checks were smooth, and the overall crowd management felt organized. Booking tickets online made the process quick and hassle-free.
Inside the auditorium, the seating was comfortable and well spaced, allowing for a relaxed viewing experience. The screen quality was sharp, and the sound system was clear and immersive, which enhanced the impact of the movie. The air-conditioning was well balanced and added to the comfort throughout the show. Cleanliness inside the hall and common areas was maintained properly.
The food and beverage counter offered the usual INOX snacks like popcorn, nachos, and soft drinks. While the prices were slightly on the higher side, the quality and taste were decent. Staff members were polite and helpful whenever assistance was needed.
Overall, INOX Raghuleela Mall Kandivali is a good option for movie lovers looking for comfort, good audio-visual quality, and a reliable cinema experience. It’s a suitable place for family outings, friends, or solo movie plans.

featured_reviews.name: Suraj Deosarkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited the INOX multiplex at Raghuleela Mega Mall in Kandivali and had a really pleasant experience overall. The location is quite convenient, especially with the mall offering ample parking and access to food courts and shopping options. As for the multiplex itself, it was clean, well-maintained, and the ambiance was quite inviting.

The staff at INOX were courteous and helpful, right from the ticket counter to the ushers inside the theater. The seating was comfortable, with good legroom and clear visibility from every angle. The sound and picture quality were up to the mark, giving a great cinematic experience. I especially liked the recliner section, which was a bit more expensive but definitely worth it for long movies.

The only reason I'm giving 4 stars instead of 5 is because the food prices at the snack counter are on the higher side, which is typical for multiplexes but still feels excessive. Also, during peak hours, the entry and exit process can feel a bit rushed and crowded.

Overall, INOX Raghuleela is a great place to watch movies with friends or family. I’d definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a good movie-going experience in Kandivali.

The multiplex features multiple screens, including 3D-enabled auditoriums with silver screens, providing immersive cinematic experiences. With a total seating capacity of 1275 across its four auditoriums, it can accommodate a significant number of moviegoers.

Beyond just movie screenings, INOX Raghuleela Mega Mall also provides food and beverage options for patrons to enjoy during their visit. Located conveniently near the National Park in Veena CHSL, Shantivan, Borivali East, Sona Gold Digital Cinema offers a cozy and budget-friendly movie-watching experience for local residents and casual visitors alike.

The theatre may not be as flashy as the big multiplexes, but it holds its charm with a nostalgic feel and a simple setup. The seats are decent and comfortable enough for a casual movie outing, and the sound and picture quality are surprisingly good for the price. It’s a great option for spontaneous plans or watching the latest releases without burning a hole in your pocket.

What stands out is the affordable ticket pricing and convenient location – perfect for locals looking to catch a film without heading to a crowded mall. Staff are polite and helpful, and entry and exit are generally smooth. While the snacks and facilities are basic, they do the job, and cleanliness is maintained reasonably well.

Pros:
- Affordable ticket prices
- Convenient location near National Park
- Decent audio-visual quality
- Friendly staff

Cons:
- Limited screen and seat capacity
- Basic amenities and snack options
- Less suitable for those looking for a premium experience

Overall, Sona Gold Digital Cinema is a reliable neighbourhood theatre that delivers on value. Great for everyday moviegoers and those who appreciate a more laid-back, no-frills cinema outing.

The lift situation wasn’t great either—there’s only one, and it barely fits five people, so getting in and out felt like a waiting game. Inside, there’s just one screen, and honestly, the theatre felt more like a small pod. The viewing experience was okay, but the sound quality could have been way better.

Showtime? More like “suggested time.” I’ve been here multiple times, and without fail, every single show starts 20–30 minutes late. Honestly, you could walk in 20 minutes after the scheduled time and still comfortably sit through a full ad marathon before the movie even begins.

At this point, missing a scene here is nearly impossible—not because of great service, but because punctuality clearly isn’t part of the experience.

It’s hard to tell whether the staff is just taking it easy or the management has created some magical, impossible turnaround schedule between shows. Either way, the result is the same: frustration.

A 2-hour movie somehow turns into a 3-hour commitment. Impressive… just not in the way you’d want.

Would not recommend if you value your time.

featured_reviews.name: Parshava Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the worst cinema experience at PVR Kandivali. To start with, water was literally leaking from the ceiling onto our seats. Instead of fixing the issue, they just threw a flimsy blue plastic sheet over the seats! It felt like sitting in a rundown shack. Some seats had broken cushions, making it incredibly uncomfortable to sit for the entire movie.

On top of that, the AC wasn’t working, and the whole theatre had a horrible damp, musty smell. It felt like they haven’t maintained the place in ages. The icing on the cake? The volume was cranked up so high, it was uncomfortable and borderline painful to sit through the movie. It didn’t enhance the experience, it made it worse.

This is hands down the worst PVR I’ve ever been to. If you’re planning to watch a movie here, do yourself a favor and go elsewhere. Total waste of time and money!

featured_reviews.name: Rikin Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing to express my disappointment with the lack of proper provision of water cups during my recent visit to your theatre.

The manager gave only one metal glass between 100 people. It was unsanitary and a potential health hazard. The show was already housefull, being aware about the situation and climate condition your managing team should be aware of it and should keep sufficient disposable water glasses. As you are aware, we are facing a global pandemic, and it is imperative that businesses take the necessary precautions to ensure the safety of their customers. Providing only one metal glass for multiple people to use is unacceptable, especially in a packed theatre where the risk of transmission is already heightened.

In addition to the lack of water cups, I was also dismayed to discover that you are charging an exorbitant price of Rs. 65 for a bottle of water. This is an unfair and unreasonable price to charge for a necessity like water, particularly when customers are already paying for movie tickets and other snacks.

Hence, this Portray sells water bottles to customers and charges exorbitant prices. I strongly urge you to reconsider your approach to providing water in your theatre. It is your responsibility as a business to ensure that your customers have access to clean drinking water, and this includes providing sufficient cups for everyone.

I hope you will take my concerns seriously and take immediate action and a resolution. Thank you for your attention to this matter.
